reassembly_note: Reassembly after T(N) steps is exact (Poincare recurrence).  But 'unscrambling' the state at step t is simply applying the inverse LINEAR map A^{T-t} — addressable in O(log t) (exp01), and it performs NO computation: it is linear algebra.  Controlling t selects among the T(N) orbit states — a piecewise-linear function with <= T(N) pieces.  Expressivity is bounded by linearity (exp01: no AND).  And information never leaves the orbit (exp02: 0.75/N of the space).
